mapper.select: select ${ filed } from SYS_RBAC_USER where user_o_code = #{userCode}

with t1 as (select a.user_o_code, A.ORG , A.USER_O_NAME, replace(substr(a.org, 2, length(org) - 2), '"', '') AS DEPART_O_CODE from sys_rbac_user a where a.user_o_code = #{loginUserCode} AND ROWNUM = 1), T2 AS (SELECT REGEXP_SUBSTR(DEPART_O_CODE, '[^,]+', 1, ROWNUM) DEPART_O_CODE , T1.user_o_code , T1.ORG , T1.USER_O_NAME FROM T1 CONNECT BY ROWNUM <= LENGTH(DEPART_O_CODE) - LENGTH(REPLACE(DEPART_O_CODE, ',', '')) + 1 ) SELECT T2.user_o_code, T2.ORG, T2.USER_O_NAME, LISTAGG(SRD.DEPT_O_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY T2.user_o_code) AS DEPT_O_NAME FROM T2 INNER JOIN SYS_RBAC_DEPART SRD ON T2.DEPART_O_CODE = SRD.DEPT_O_CODE group by T2.user_o_code, T2.ORG, T2.USER_O_NAME

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T1.R_ID, T1.ACCOUNT, T1.USER_O_CODE, T1.USER_O_NAME, T1.JY_INSERT_TIME, T1.JY_UPDATE_TIME, T1.FINANCIER, '0' FLAG, T1.ENABLED, null applyId FROM SYS_RBAC_USER T1 UNION SELECT T2.R_ID, T2.ACCOUNT, T2.USER_O_CODE, T2.USER_O_NAME, T2.APPLY_TIME AS JY_INSERT_TIME, NULL AS JY_UPDATE_TIME, T2.FINANCIER, '1' FLAG, T2.ENABLED, T2.APPLY_ID as applyId FROM SYS_RBAC_USER_APPLY T2 where T2.STATUS = 'PENDING' ) T
AND T.ACCOUNT LIKE '%' || #{account,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND T.USER_O_NAME LIKE '%' || #{userOName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
ORDER BY T.JY_INSERT_TIME DESC

SELECT t.R_ID,t.ACCOUNT,t.USER_O_CODE,t.USER_O_NAME,t.JY_INSERT_TIME,t.JY_UPDATE_TIME,t.FINANCIER,'0' FLAG,t.ENABLED,F.ROLE_CODE FROM SYS_RBAC_USER T LEFT JOIN SYS_RBAC_ROLE_RELATE F ON F.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.USER_O_CODE = F.R_CODE1 WHERE T.ENABLED = '1' AND (F.ROLE_CODE != #{roleCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or F.ROLE_CODE is null )
AND T.ACCOUNT LIKE '%' || #{account,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND T.USER_O_NAME LIKE '%' || #{userOName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
ORDER BY t.JY_UPDATE_TIME DESC

select t.R_ID,t.ACCOUNT,t.USER_O_CODE,t.USER_O_NAME,t.JY_INSERT_TIME,t.JY_UPDATE_TIME,t.FINANCIER from ( SELECT distinct t.R_ID,t.ACCOUNT,t.USER_O_CODE,t.USER_O_NAME,t.JY_INSERT_TIME,t.JY_UPDATE_TIME,t.FINANCIER FROM SYS_RBAC_USER T LEFT JOIN SYS_RBAC_ROLE_RELATE F ON T.USER_O_CODE = F.R_CODE1 LEFT JOIN SYS_RBAC_ROLE R ON F.ROLE_CODE = R.ROLE_O_CODE WHERE T.ENABLED = '1' AND R.ROLE_O_NAME like '%' || #{roleName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND T.FINANCIER LIKE '%' || #{userManager,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND T.USER_O_NAME LIKE '%' || #{userOName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
) t order by t.R_ID
